rationale:
Independent judgment: APPROVE the consultation direction. RAW_COMMITS and RAW_DIFF_STATS are empty (SHA e3b0c442...), so this is a standalone direction/second-opinion after an actual native CPU FAIL, not a code change. My task is to verify that the reported outcome and the recommended shortest-safe path are honest and do not mislabel FAIL as success, close findings administratively, borrow the reserved reviewer/whole-plan pair, bypass installed checks, or authorize compute.

The failure is genuine and correctly classified. NATIVE_FAILURE_PRIVATE (exit 1, status FAIL, gpu=false, patient_data=false, network_permission=false, package_unchanged=true, console untruncated) and the terminal poll (1), asset row (status UNCERTAIN as the generic nonzero-exit class with the full 1.118950 reservation RETAINED, not released), billing (no matching row, partial hour excluded, ledger_mutations=0, new_compute=0, model_calls=0) are mutually consistent and preserve originals and safeguards.

The root cause is an author-owned scientific fixture bug, verified directly: execution.py:1703 (_native_diagnostic_fixture) builds the plans dict from SyntheticPlans.json WITHOUT continue_training, whereas the base rehearsal (1670) and production (1250) wrap it as dict(..., continue_training=...); nnUNetTrainer.__init__ does plans.pop('continue_training'), raising KeyError exactly as the traceback shows. The base rehearsal segments ran (train/val epochs, Mean Validation Dice 0.0 in the console) before the fixture construction raised, so no success is being claimed; the nonzero exit is faithful. This is precisely the class of defect that review14's genuine REVISE (single finding DIAG-U2-changed-module-native-integration-unverified) required actual native integration to surface, and that finding remains open and does not release any whole-plan/coverage/execution hold.

Installed guards enforce the claimed limits. native_runtime.native_result() requires observed status==VERIFIED and exit_code==0, so a FAIL cannot be promoted to a READY/PASS asset row; review_runtime reviewer15 delivery (attach.ready) requires diagnostic_native_evidence==marker(), which depends on that same VERIFIED native receipt — so reviewer15 genuinely cannot be convened on this failure without a separate, independently reviewed equivalent handoff, matching START_HERE. No automatic retry (start-intent written, existing-attempt reconcile refuses replay). Operator authority hashes (DIAGNOSTIC_DECISION 5748a56f, NATIVE_REVIEW14_REPORT 0cf4671c) and caps ($25/$150/$1200/$1275) are consistent across source and evidence; no new or outside-cap money decision is pending for the already-authorized first RunB.

The recommended direction — a bounded author correction targeting the exact continue_training fixture error, then independent reviewer15 judgment via a minimally-scoped reviewed handoff, preserving all original attempts/charges, whole-plan/coverage/projection holds, with no second CPU rehearsal and no automatic GPU retry — is the shortest safe path and adds no unnecessary infrastructure. I found no unresolved issue in any fixed category (test-set/leakage, code/spec mismatch, metric/statistic, privacy/secret, budget, execution authority/provenance). analysis_entrypoint is null: there is no orchestrator.analysis_driver in scope and this is a direction consultation, not an analysis-driver run. Findings are therefore empty and the verdict is APPROVE.
